prompt: Redraw as a grand wizard academy: a tall round grey stone tower five storeys high with tall arched windows, joined to a two-storey stone hall with a large arched doorway, several slim pointed purple spires with twisted tips. CLEAN freshly painted plaster, no dirt, no grime, no cracks, no stains. The building shell ONLY: NO brooms, NO lanterns, NO cauldrons, NO barrels, NO crates, NO plants, NO signs, NO people, NO ground or base plate. Whole building centred, front three-quarter view, plain light grey background, nothing cut off.
